title: Kara Murat: Fatih'in Fedaisi
writer: Rahmi Turan, Abdullah Turhan, Erdogan Tünas
actors: Cüneyt Arkin, Bora Ayanoglu, Atilla Ergün
plot: Mehmed the Conqueror sends Kara Murat to stop Prince of Wallachia, Vlad the Impaler aka Vlad III Dracula, the historical inspiration for the vampire Count Dracula.
